evolution.aspect: Pacing intelligence — duration intent, cut velocity, emotional velocity, breath beats, L-cuts
evolution.benchmark_task: Write AI video prompts for a 30-second Authority Flywheel testimonial-style video that feels human-directed
evolution.key_insight: Current skill treats shots as independent architectural units. Zero vocabulary for temporal relationships between shots. Breath beats (non-narrative pacing shots) and L-cuts (audio-visual desync) are the two highest-leverage anti-AI-aesthetic techniques.

notes: First evolution. Added Temporal Dramaturgy Architecture — encodes pacing, rhythm, and emotional arc into prompt sequences. Three sub-patterns: Breath Beat, L-Cut as Anti-AI Signature, Duration Intent taxonomy (LINGER/STANDARD/SNAP/FLASH). Strictly additive to existing Cinematic Formula + Decoupling Law.
